verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Feature Change Requests as a four-eyes create/approve/publish workflow, with a configurable number of required approvals before a change request is applied. Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when flags are promoted to production. RBAC can also restrict who may modify production environments. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that approval gating works in practice, and explicit documentation of per-environment enforcement scope.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Feature Change Requests help creating a four-eyes workflow (create, approve, publish) to updating feature flags, similarly to Pull Requests in GitHub.
Select the required number of approvals for each Change Request to be applied.
Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
